sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/351 (ReserveOhio API ohiordr.usedirect.com: search/place PlaceId 351, search/grid facilities 442 'Geneva Campground' and 852 'Geneva Premium Full Hook Up' for 2027-06-15 and 2027-01-12, search/details for every unit on 2027-06-15, plus sites 001, 038, 094 and 101 on 2027-06-19, 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12, read 2026-10-30)

values.note: Non-electric sites $29 a night, electric $39, full hookups $52; the 20 premium full-hookup sites overlooking Lake Erie (101-120) $75. The same on a Saturday (June 2027). Off-peak (November 2026, January 2027) non-electric $25, electric and full-hookup $35, premium $65. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-30.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all Geneva campsites, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Non-Electric 29.00 with 40-ft pads and trailer map icons, Campsite Electric 39.00, Campsite Full Hookup 52.00 in 'Geneva Campground' and 75.00 in 'Geneva Premium Full Hook Up', Fee 6.50); sites 094, 001, 038, 101 on Sat 2027-06-19 (29.00 / 39.00 / 52.00 / 75.00), 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12 (25.00 / 35.00 / 35.00 / 65.00), read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: ReserveOhio search/details (electric and full-hookup sites list Electricity Hookup '20,30,50' / '20/30/50 Amp'; 38 full-hookup sites list Water Hookup and Sewer Hookup 'Yes') + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/geneva-state-park-campground ('20 premium, full-service, campsites overlooking Lake Erie', '39 Full hook-up sites', '74 Electric sites'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 118 web-bookable sites: 7 non-electric (40-ft pads), 72 electric (45 ft), 19 full hookup and 20 premium full hookup (101-120, paved, 38-90 ft). Four full-hookup sites are pull-through, the rest back-in. Pets allowed on all sites.

sites.source: ReserveOhio search/grid (442: 98 units, 852: 20 units) + search/details (PullInTypeName 'Back In' / 'Pull Through', Maximum Camping Unit Length 38-90, Pad Length 40 on the non-electric sites) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/geneva-state-park-campground ('Pets are allowed on all sites.'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Seasonal camp store (440-466-5069) with firewood, ice and supplies and games to borrow; fish cleaning house for registered campers.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/geneva-state-park-campground ('Showerhouse with flush toilets and coin-operated laundry'; 'A seasonal camp store (440-466-5069) offers firewood, ice, and camping supplies'; 'Fish cleaning house for registered campers only'; 'Dump station is available'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Off-peak November 1 to March 31: no water ('Dump station is available. Water is not available. Sites 38 through 52, 88, 90, 92 and 93 are electric and sewer only. Sites 53 through 91 are electric only'). The premium sites are not sold in winter (all 20 blocked in January 2027); 35 of 98 sites in the main loop were free.

season.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/geneva-state-park-campground ('Off-Peak Season: From November 1 to March 31. Dump station is available. Water is not available. ...') + ReserveOhio search/grid 2027-01-12 (442: 35 free, 63 blocked; 852: 20 blocked), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 'Reservations are required and may be made online or by calling (866) 644-6727.' Every site, the premium lakeside ones included, is web-bookable by the night on ReserveOhio with a 14-night maximum.

booking.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/geneva-state-park-campground ('Reservations are required and may be made online or by calling (866) 644-6727.') + ReserveOhio search/details (AllowWebBooking true, MaxStay 14, on all 118 sites incl. 101-120), read 2026-10-30

summary: Fees confirmed ($29 non-electric RV base, +$10 electric, +$23 full hookup) with the high raised 29->75 for the premium lakeside sites; off-peak rates added. Added 50-amp electric (water/sewer confirmed), 118 sites to 90 ft with 4 pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/dump/laundry/camp store, year-round with the no-water off-peak rule, ReserveOhio deep link, reservations required, 14-night max. AWH note kept verbatim. The lakefront sites AWH describes are the 20 Premium Full Hook Up sites 101-120, $75 a night, bookable nightly. Pin fine (87 m from the centroid).
flags: Phone missing: the ODNR campground page lists (440) 466-5069 (also the seasonal camp store); the park office on the park page is (440) 466-8400.

Waterfront (stored lakefront), the brief's question: the 'few rather expensive full-hookup sites that are lakefront' are ReserveOhio's separate facility 'Geneva Premium Full Hook Up', sites 101-120, which ODNR describes as '20 premium, full-service, campsites overlooking Lake Erie'. They are bookable by the night (AllowWebBooking true, 14-night max) at $75 ($65 off-peak), but are not sold in winter. Their sites sit 400+ m north-west of the main loop (centroid of the 20 premium sites 41.85494,-80.98878); the stored pin is on the main loop, so the lakefront call rests on a section a different pin would show. Pin otherwise fine: 87 m from the 118-site centroid 41.85114,-80.98625.
